01 / CONTRIBUTION

Product design & Flutter development

Designed and developed miao: its Arabic product experience, Vortex identity, Flutter mobile journeys, shared components and administration tools.

  • Created a mint-and-charcoal visual language with a distinctive Vortex wordmark, rounded cards and considered motion.
  • Built listing discovery, search, filters, favorites and photo-led publishing.
  • Connected missing-cat reports with a map-based browsing experience.
  • Implemented conversations, order follow-up and shared administration tools.
Scope & status

Original product identity and implementation by Hussein Abozina. The gallery contains owner-supplied captures of the Android app.

Behind the interface.

Arabic at the center
